# Explore Our **Shared Humanity**

A million world wonders. 10,000 years of history. An ongoing exploration of the human experience.

[Book Tickets](/tickets)

![Rendering of the new Egypt Gallery.](https://www.penn.museum/img/homepage/on-view-preview-egypt.jpg)

###### Opening December 12, 2026

### [Egypt Galleries: Life and Afterlife](/on-view/galleries-exhibitions/egypt-galleries/life-and-afterlife)

Explore more than 1,000 artifacts spanning 4,000 years illuminating how ancient Egyptians lived, worked, worshipped, and prepared for eternity.

*Included with admission*

![The Ram in the Thicket statue.](https://www.penn.museum/img/homepage/reskin/ram-in-thicket.jpg)

## [What's On View](/on-view/galleries-exhibitions)

Connect with vibrant cultures of the world, from the very first cities of the Middle East to the lives of Native American communities today.

![The Main Entrance during fall.](https://www.penn.museum/img/homepage/20231106_SUCAR_089.jpg)

## [Plan Your Visit](/visit/plan-your-visit)

**The Penn Museum is open to all.**  
3260 South Street, Philadelphia, PA 19014  
Open Tuesday through Sunday: 10:00 am – 5:00 pm

![Mockup of the new Lower Egypt Galleries.](https://www.penn.museum/img/homepage/reskin/membership-banner-egypt.jpg)

### Join now for the journey of a lifetime

Be among the first to experience the new [**Egypt Galleries: Life & Afterlife**](/on-view/galleries-exhibitions/egypt-galleries/life-and-afterlife), opening December 12. Members enjoy free admission year-round, invitations to Member Mornings, free virtual subscription to *Artifact in Action* lectures, and more.

[Become a Member](/join-give/membership)

- ### [Artifacts in Action](/calendar/1736/artifacts-in-action-virtual-lecture)

  Wednesday, Dec. 2, **Dr. Elisa Palomino Perez** shares extraordinary garments that reflect the Nanai People’s generations of knowledge and close relationship with the natural world

  ![An fishskin garment.](https://www.penn.museum/img/homepage/events/aia-dec26.jpg)

- ### [Mind & Mood Recharge powered by Penn Medicine](/events/recharge)

  First Wednesdays, we're open late with wellness activities for all levels from local practitioners of yoga, meditation, sound healing, and more.

  ![A yoga instructor in lotus pose in the Asia Galleries.](https://www.penn.museum/img/homepage/events/mind-mood-2026.jpg)

- ### [Up Late with the Sphinx](/events/up-late-with-the-sphinx)

  Explore the galleries after dark during an epic evening of family fun.

## [AP: Iraq’s Yazidis rediscover lost history through photos found in a museum archive](https://apnews.com/article/yazidi-history-photos-found-iraq-islamic-state-55a68cc4e5644f868411366755252e3b)

Photographs rediscovered in the Penn Museum Archives reveal scenes from daily life in 1930s northern Iraq, preserving a community’s history nearly erased by ISIS destruction and exile.
